nodes.source: Ken took me home, I fell asleep on the sofa and eventually got up to bed in the early hours.
nodes.text: Ken kørte mig hjem. Jeg faldt i søvn på sofaen og kom først i seng ud på de små timer.

nodes.source: 26th February 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 26. februar 2005 - lørdag

nodes.source: Ken came in to my room to say farewell early this morning as he was off on a short break to see his family for a while. I slept in for a while afterwards.
nodes.text: Ken kom ind tidligt for at sige farvel, da han skulle på en kort tur og besøge familien. Jeg sov videre bagefter.

nodes.source: So I was up around 12pm and a friend had arrived to look after me and keep me company until Sunday.
nodes.text: Jeg stod altså op omkring kl. 12, og en veninde var ankommet for at passe på mig og holde mig med selskab til søndag.

nodes.source: Masonic ceremony day today, I really wanted to be able to attend as this was an important goal for me to achieve following my treatment. After all, I had bought all the bits I needed the previous Saturday and somehow had managed to learn some important lines in between being sick and chemotherapy!
nodes.text: Frimurerceremoni i dag. Jeg ville virkelig gerne deltage, for det var et vigtigt mål efter behandlingen. Jeg havde jo købt alt det nødvendige sidste lørdag og på en eller anden måde lært vigtige replikker mellem opkast og kemoterapi!

nodes.source: Found the energy from somewhere, got myself smartly dressed and left my house around 2.30pm.
nodes.text: Fandt energi et sted, klædte mig pænt på og gik hjemmefra omkring kl. 14.30.

nodes.source: I took it very easy indeed, was extremely glad I had made it out, completed my part of a lengthy ceremony word perfectly and even managed to stay for the meal afterwards. I picked at the food but made a good effort to get some of it inside me.
nodes.text: Jeg tog den meget roligt og var enormt glad for at være kommet ud. Gennemførte min del af en lang ceremoni ordret og blev endda til måltidet bagefter. Jeg nippede til maden, men gjorde en god indsats for at få noget ned.

nodes.source: When the meal had finished, I was very tired after a long day and soon went to bed once home.
nodes.text: Da middagen var slut, var jeg meget træt efter den lange dag og gik snart i seng hjemme.

nodes.source: 27th February 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 27. februar 2005 - søndag

nodes.source: Woke up quite early today but soon retired back to bed and didn't get up until about 3pm!!
nodes.text: Vågnede ret tidligt, men gik snart i seng igen og stod først op omkring kl. 15!!

nodes.source: Although in and out of sleep for most of the day I managed to watch some TV and, more importantly, eat a little food!
nodes.text: Selvom jeg sov til og fra det meste af dagen, fik jeg set lidt tv og, vigtigere, spist lidt mad!

nodes.source: My friend decided to stay at my house another night and leave in the morning. My Dad is due to arrive late morning to stay with me for the week ahead.
nodes.text: Min veninde besluttede at blive en ekstra nat og tage af sted i morgen. Min far kommer sidst på formiddagen og skal være hos mig den kommende uge.

nodes.source: Despite sleeping for a good majority of the day, I still felt really tired tonight. Once I made sure my friend had everything she needed and was comfortable I retired to bed for another full night's sleep.
nodes.text: Trods søvn det meste af dagen var jeg virkelig træt i aften. Da jeg havde sikret, at min veninde havde det behageligt og alt, hvad hun behøvede, gik jeg i seng til endnu en hel nats søvn.

nodes.source: 28th February 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 28. februar 2005 - mandag

nodes.source: Shortly after getting up, my Dad arrived.
nodes.text: Kort efter jeg stod op, kom min far.

nodes.source: Spent the day catching up with my Dad and, although weak, managed to eat a little and start to plan my week ahead, starting with a blood test tomorrow.
nodes.text: Brugte dagen på at snakke med far. Selvom jeg var svag, fik jeg lidt at spise og begyndte at planlægge ugen, først en blodprøve i morgen.

nodes.source: There is so much I want to do but just cannot motivate myself to do it, the truth is I just don't have the energy yet. It annoys me that there are things I want to do but just cannot muster the energy to do them. This chemotherapy in my system is going to take some serious flushing for me to get back to anywhere near normal.
nodes.text: Der er så meget, jeg gerne vil, men jeg kan bare ikke få mig selv til det. Sandheden er, at energien ikke er der endnu. Det irriterer mig at ville noget uden at kunne samle kræfterne. Kemoterapien i kroppen skal virkelig skylles ud, før jeg kommer i nærheden af normalen.

nodes.source: March 2005
nodes.text: marts 2005

nodes.source: 1st March 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 1. marts 2005 - tirsdag

nodes.source: Got to Charing X about an hour late for my blood test. My Dad accompanied me to the hospital and joined me for a chat with my Doctor. Routine discussions; my treatment has progressed well, now it's recovery time for my body before any operations are carried out.
nodes.text: Kom cirka en time for sent til blodprøven på Charing Cross. Far var med og deltog i snakken med lægen. Rutinesamtale: Behandlingen er gået godt. Nu skal kroppen komme sig, før der opereres.

nodes.source: Spent a considerable amount of time wandering about on the 6th floor catching up with Milton and the staff while waiting for my blood test results. Once they were finally through, I managed to grab the registrar on the 6th floor to discuss them.
nodes.text: Brugte en del tid på at gå rundt på 6. etage og snakke med Milton og personalet, mens jeg ventede på blodprøvesvar. Da de endelig kom, fik jeg fat i reservelægen på 6. etage og drøftet dem.

nodes.source: My blood health is low but that is to be expected. I wasn't planning on doing anything apart from recovering at home, so the registrar didn't recommend any further medication or injections and gave me a cautionary chat about looking after myself and allowed me to go home.
nodes.text: Mine blodtal er lave, men det er forventeligt. Jeg havde ikke planer om andet end at komme mig hjemme, så reservelægen anbefalede ingen ekstra medicin eller indsprøjtninger, gav mig en advarende snak om at passe på mig selv og lod mig tage hjem.

nodes.source: A quick visit to the local DIY store en route home.
nodes.text: Et hurtigt besøg i det lokale byggemarked på vejen hjem.

nodes.source: Once home, managed a little dinner and relaxed in front of the TV before hitting the sack.
nodes.text: Hjemme fik jeg lidt aftensmad og slappede af foran tv'et før sengetid.

nodes.source: 2nd March 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 2. marts 2005 - onsdag

nodes.source: Woke up not really feeling refreshed at all. Managed to get myself up and dressed but not much more. A little breakfast and I hit the sofa for the rest of the day.
nodes.text: Vågnede uden overhovedet at føle mig udhvilet. Fik mig op og i tøjet, men ikke meget mere. Lidt morgenmad og så på sofaen resten af dagen.

nodes.source: Often snoozing, I found that if I tried to motivate myself to do anything I would just get out of breath and my heart would beat faster and harder.
nodes.text: Jeg døsede ofte og opdagede, at hvis jeg prøvede at få mig selv til noget, blev jeg forpustet, og hjertet slog hurtigere og hårdere.

nodes.source: If I were to mark my health and how I feel out of 10, I'd say I was at about a 6.
nodes.text: Skulle jeg give helbredet og mit velbefindende karakter ud af ti, ville det være omkring seks.

nodes.source: 3rd March 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 3. marts 2005 - torsdag

nodes.source: Much the same as yesterday; spent the day on the sofa. My little health marker I've made up in my head is still at about a 6.
nodes.text: Omtrent som i går, hele dagen på sofaen. Mit lille selvopfundne helbredstal er stadig cirka seks.

nodes.source: 4th March 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 4. marts 2005 - fredag

nodes.source: Still much the same, spent the day on the sofa feeling very lethargic indeed. My little health marker now at about 5.
nodes.text: Stadig omtrent det samme, dagen på sofaen og meget sløv. Mit lille helbredstal er nu cirka fem.

nodes.source: 5th March 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 5. marts 2005 - lørdag

nodes.source: Still much the same, spent the day on the sofa. Sleeping lots and getting tired very quickly, even if I attempt to move about too much on the sofa. My little health marker still at about a 5.
nodes.text: Stadig det samme, dagen på sofaen. Sover meget og bliver hurtigt træt, selv når jeg bare bevæger mig for meget på sofaen. Helbredstallet er stadig cirka fem.

nodes.source: 6th March 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 6. marts 2005 - søndag

nodes.source: Still much the same, spent the day on the sofa. Sleeping lots and getting tired very quickly, even if I attempt to move about too much on the sofa.
nodes.text: Stadig det samme, dagen på sofaen. Sover meget og bliver hurtigt træt, selv når jeg bare bevæger mig for meget på sofaen.

nodes.source: Very frustrating indeed, there's so much I want to achieve and even the smallest things seem like too much of a chore.
nodes.text: Virkelig frustrerende. Jeg vil nå så meget, men selv de mindste ting virker som en for stor opgave.

nodes.source: One thing I really wanted to do was get to see my Mum today, being Mother's Day. It just wasn't going to happen; I could not muster the energy to even lift myself from the sofa. This made me quite disappointed indeed.
nodes.text: Noget, jeg virkelig gerne ville i dag, var at besøge mor på mors dag. Det kunne simpelthen ikke lade sig gøre. Jeg kunne ikke engang finde kræfter til at løfte mig fra sofaen. Det gjorde mig meget skuffet.

nodes.source: I have been eating, but sporadically, and there really hasn't been much I've particularly fancied at all. Still, my Dad has persevered and managed to get me to eat a decent meal each night.
nodes.text: Jeg har spist, men sporadisk, og jeg har ikke haft særlig lyst til noget. Far har dog holdt ved og fået mig til at spise et ordentligt måltid hver aften.

nodes.source: My little health marker now at about a 4. I reckon I'm most certainly due for a blood transfusion this coming week and said as much to my Dad.
nodes.text: Mit lille helbredstal er nu omkring fire. Jeg regner bestemt med en blodtransfusion i den kommende uge og sagde det til far.

nodes.source: 7th March 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 7. marts 2005 - mandag

nodes.source: My Dad left early this morning for his home, after spending the whole of last week looking after me. Also fitting in quite a bit of DIY that needed doing too!
nodes.text: Far tog tidligt hjem i morges efter at have passet mig hele sidste uge og også nået en del tiltrængt gør-det-selv!

nodes.source: I rested and slept on the sofa for the rest of the day.
nodes.text: Jeg hvilede og sov på sofaen resten af dagen.

nodes.source: I reckon health marker probably at a 3 by now!
nodes.text: Helbredstallet er nok nede på tre nu!

nodes.source: 8th March 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 8. marts 2005 - tirsdag

nodes.source: Got myself moving this morning, I really don't know where I found the energy from. Drove myself in to Charing Cross for my blood test.
nodes.text: Fik mig i gang i morges. Jeg aner ikke, hvor energien kom fra. Kørte selv til Charing Cross til blodprøven.

nodes.source: Spoke with the registrar immediately after bloods were taken and nipped up to the 6th floor to see who was about while waiting for my results.
nodes.text: Talte med reservelægen straks efter blodprøven og smuttede op på 6. etage for at se, hvem der var der, mens jeg ventede på svar.

nodes.source: I knew I wasn't feeling well but once I returned for my results at Clinic 8, I was told that I wasn't going home and was to be admitted - to an isolation room!!!
nodes.text: Jeg vidste, at jeg ikke havde det godt, men da jeg kom tilbage til klinik 8 efter svar, fik jeg at vide, at jeg ikke skulle hjem. Jeg skulle indlægges på en isolationsstue!!!

nodes.source: My blood health was so poor I was in quite a bit of danger. Black outs, internal bleeding, serious infections; to mention some of the possible things that could have happened to me if my blood and I were left alone to get any worse!
nodes.text: Mine blodtal var så dårlige, at jeg var i betydelig fare. Besvimelser, indre blødninger, alvorlige infektioner er blot noget af det, der kunne ske, hvis blodet og jeg blev overladt til os selv og fik det værre!

nodes.source: It seems the cumulative effects of my chemotherapy had really kicked in and my bone marrow was simply not functioning correctly enough to produce goodness for my blood.
nodes.text: Den samlede effekt af kemoterapien var åbenbart virkelig slået igennem. Knoglemarven fungerede simpelthen ikke godt nok til at producere det gode til blodet.

nodes.source: After waiting 6 hours for my room to be allocated (a friend had arrived to keep me company) I was moved up to the familiar 6th floor, this time on the North wing in to a room of my very own.
nodes.text: Efter seks timers venten på en stue, med en ven hos mig, blev jeg flyttet til den velkendte 6. etage. Denne gang i North-fløjen på mit helt eget værelse.

nodes.source: 1 GCSF injection and immediately on Antibiotics (Amoxicillin 500mg).
nodes.text: Én GCSF-indsprøjtning og straks antibiotika, Amoxicillin 500 mg.

nodes.source: Cannulated twice, the first time failed, eventually the first unit of blood to be transfused was begun. Following which I was transfused 1 pool of platelets and then a following further 2 units of blood. All this would go through the night and my observations were carried out at very close intervals due to the feverish side effects both blood and platelets can give you. No sleep for me!
nodes.text: Jeg fik lagt venflon to gange, da det første forsøg mislykkedes. Til sidst begyndte transfusionen af den første portion blod. Derefter fik jeg transfunderet én pool af blodplader og så yderligere to portioner blod. Alt dette skulle fortsætte natten igennem, og mine værdier blev kontrolleret med meget korte mellemrum på grund af de feberagtige bivirkninger, som både blod og blodplader kan give. Ingen søvn til mig!

nodes.source: Together with some friends, I managed to get some clothes and my usual hospital gear brought to me this evening. Remember I only drove in for a blood test earlier and was not expecting to be admitted!
nodes.text: Med hjælp fra venner fik jeg tøj og mit sædvanlige hospitalsudstyr bragt i aften. Husk, jeg kørte kun ind efter en blodprøve og ventede ikke at blive indlagt!

nodes.source: I was sick this evening. Not sure why, may have been the stress of coming back in unexpectedly or simply just the ongoing effects of my poor state of health.
nodes.text: Jeg kastede op i aften. Ved ikke hvorfor. Måske stress over uventet indlæggelse eller bare fortsatte virkninger af mit dårlige helbred.

nodes.source: Being in isolation meant strict hygiene and contact with others was at a minimum.
nodes.text: Isolation betød streng hygiejne og mindst mulig kontakt med andre.

nodes.source: 9th March 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 9. marts 2005 - onsdag

nodes.source: Three months since diagnosis today. It passed without me noticing.
nodes.text: Tre måneder siden diagnosen i dag. Det gik forbi uden, at jeg bemærkede det.

nodes.source: I slept for a fair bit today. Someone came over to visit, I doubt I was much company.
nodes.text: Jeg sov en del i dag. Nogen kom på besøg, men jeg var næppe meget selskab.

nodes.source: They took another blood test, a very slight improvement. Another 1 unit of blood was required, managed to get this in during the evening and was left alone for a good night's sleep.
nodes.text: En ny blodprøve viste en meget lille forbedring. Der var behov for endnu en portion blod. Den fik jeg om aftenen og blev derefter ladt i fred til en god nats søvn.

nodes.source: 10th March 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 10. marts 2005 - torsdag

nodes.source: Slept really well. Observation day today, if no improvement is found in the level of my platelets today, another pool of platelets will be required.
nodes.text: Sov rigtig godt. Observationsdag i dag. Hvis blodpladerne ikke er bedre, skal jeg have endnu en portion.

nodes.source: Fortunately my bloods had recovered suitably well enough for me to just be observed for the day.
nodes.text: Heldigvis var blodet kommet sig tilstrækkeligt til, at jeg bare skulle observeres i dag.

nodes.source: My health had certainly picked up a lot more today and spent most of it in bed watching daytime TV!
nodes.text: Mit helbred var bestemt meget bedre. Det meste af dagen lå jeg i sengen og så dag-tv!

nodes.source: No need for isolation hygiene requirements anymore. I was free to leave the room and take more visitors. A few visitors came over this evening after which I got myself another brilliant and undisturbed night's sleep.
nodes.text: Ikke længere krav om isolationshygiejne. Jeg kunne forlade værelset og få flere besøgende. Der kom nogle i aften, og bagefter fik jeg endnu en fantastisk, uforstyrret nats søvn.

nodes.source: 11th March 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 11. marts 2005 - fredag

nodes.source: Slept really well again and felt so much better.
nodes.text: Sov virkelig godt igen og havde det så meget bedre.

nodes.source: Stuck the daytime TV on, observations taken. I eagerly awaited my blood test today as the results would determine whether I was to be discharged.
nodes.text: Tændte for dag-tv og fik taget observationer. Ventede spændt på blodprøven, hvis svar ville afgøre udskrivningen.

nodes.source: I waited some time for my blood test to be taken. The ward was quite busy today as I think they had a very poorly patient whom I had seen them rushing an emergency crash cart to. During my short stay this week I had seen many distressed relatives. Death is something which you become almost oblivious to, especially spending time on a Cancer ward, you know it's happening but shield yourself from the suffering.
nodes.text: Ventede en del på blodprøven. Der var travlt, vist med en meget dårlig patient, som de skyndte en akutvogn hen til. Under mit korte ophold har jeg set mange fortvivlede pårørende. Døden bliver noget, man næsten lukker af for, især på en kræftafdeling. Man ved, at det sker, men beskytter sig mod lidelsen.

nodes.source: I waited patiently and carried on with my new daytime TV addiction.
nodes.text: Jeg ventede tålmodigt og fortsatte min nye afhængighed af dag-tv.

nodes.source: Finally the registrar decided to do the blood test, as I had not been seen to for ages. They were marked urgent and I awaited the results.
nodes.text: Til sidst tog reservelægen selv blodprøven, da ingen havde set til mig længe. Den blev markeret som hasteprøve, og jeg ventede på svar.

nodes.source: Everything apart from my Magnesium levels had returned to reasonable levels and I was to be discharged as soon as my cannulation was removed and my TTA (To Take Away) medications allocated. Apparently the TTA's were already ready but due to how busy the ward was today, I waited a further 5 hours to be discharged (I think they had thought I'd already left or had forgotten about me. Instead I was happily laying in bed watching the box and chatting to a friend who had been with me for the whole day).
nodes.text: Alt undtagen magnesium var tilbage på rimelige niveauer, og jeg kunne udskrives, når kanylen var fjernet og min TTA-medicin, 'To Take Away', var udleveret. Den var åbenbart klar allerede, men på grund af travlheden ventede jeg yderligere fem timer. Jeg tror, de troede, jeg var gået, eller havde glemt mig. Jeg lå nu glad i sengen, så tv og snakkede med en ven, som havde været her hele dagen.

nodes.source: My Magnesium deficiency is down to the damage that the Cisplatin or the 'P' of BEP chemotherapy has done to my body. This is something that will now have to be monitored carefully during each of my blood tests although the doctors do not seem to be overly concerned. There is so much, outside of killing cancer, that chemotherapy does to your body. Killing cancer cells is the desired result, the rest just has to be dealt with as and when it becomes apparent.
nodes.text: Magnesiummanglen skyldes den skade, Cisplatin, altså 'P' i BEP-kemoterapien, har påført kroppen. Det skal nu følges nøje ved hver blodprøve, selvom lægerne ikke virker voldsomt bekymrede. Kemoterapi gør så meget ved kroppen ud over at dræbe kræft. Kræftcellernes død er det ønskede resultat. Resten må man håndtere, efterhånden som det viser sig.

nodes.source: I left the hospital at exactly the time I thought I would, right in the thick of the rush hour on a Friday night heading out of London. It was not good.
nodes.text: Jeg forlod hospitalet præcis på det tidspunkt, jeg havde regnet med: midt i fredagens myldretid ud af London. Det var ikke godt.

nodes.source: Once home, I relaxed in front of the TV, ate a huge 2 helpings of chicken and pasta for dinner which someone kindly prepared for me and soon retired for the evening.
nodes.text: Hjemme slappede jeg af foran tv'et, spiste to store portioner kylling og pasta, som nogen venligt lavede, og gik snart i seng.

nodes.source: 12th March 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 12. marts 2005 - lørdag

nodes.source: No entries for today.
nodes.text: Ingen indlæg i dag.

nodes.source: 13th March 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 13. marts 2005 - søndag

nodes.source: No entries for today.
nodes.text: Ingen indlæg i dag.

nodes.source: 14th March 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 14. marts 2005 - mandag

nodes.source: No entries for today.
nodes.text: Ingen indlæg i dag.

nodes.source: 15th March 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 15. marts 2005 - tirsdag

nodes.source: I'm back!
nodes.text: Jeg er tilbage!

nodes.source: I've updated some of my missing diary entries as best as I can remember them (more to follow soon), right back until the 20th February 2005 and, after a lot of typing, hope you enjoy the read! Apologies for not keeping you all posted on my progress recently, I have been weak at times, convalescing at others. I was sure you'd understand and know your thoughts and prayers were with me during what has been one of the tougher times for me.
nodes.text: Jeg har udfyldt nogle manglende indlæg så godt, jeg husker dem, helt tilbage til den 20. februar 2005. Mere følger snart. Efter en masse skrivning håber jeg, I nyder læsningen! Undskyld, at jeg ikke har holdt jer orienteret på det seneste. Jeg har til tider været svag og ellers været ved at komme mig. Jeg var sikker på jeres forståelse og vidste, at jeres tanker og bønner var med mig i en af de sværere perioder.

nodes.source: Woke up after a long sleep and readied myself for my hospital visit, hopefully today they'll let me go home!
nodes.text: Vågnede efter en lang søvn og gjorde klar til hospitalet. Forhåbentlig lader de mig tage hjem i dag!

nodes.source: A friend has been staying at my house looking after me for sometime now, it's nice not to have to spend the time at home alone and to have someone around reminding me to eat and helping me with cooking etc.
nodes.text: En ven har boet hos mig og passet på mig et stykke tid. Det er rart ikke at være alene hjemme og have nogen til at minde mig om at spise og hjælpe med madlavning osv.

nodes.source: A quick breakfast and some orange juice and my friend and I sped off to the hospital.
nodes.text: En hurtig morgenmad og appelsinjuice, og så skyndte min ven og jeg os til hospitalet.

nodes.source: Arrived at Charing Cross Clinic 8 on the 1st floor for my blood test, whilst waiting for the results made myself busy visiting Milton, some other fellow patients and staff up on the 6th floor.
nodes.text: Kom til klinik 8 på 1. etage på Charing Cross til blodprøven. Mens jeg ventede på svar, holdt jeg mig beskæftiget med at besøge Milton, andre medpatienter og personalet på 6. etage.

nodes.source: After about 2 hours, I went down to get my results and had a chat with the registrar. My general blood health is on the up, with most of the individual readings from my blood looking more positive than the previous week. Simply put, that means my blood health is not quite at its best but certainly looking like it's heading in the right direction.
nodes.text: Efter cirka to timer gik jeg ned efter svar og talte med reservelægen. Blodet er i bedring, og de fleste tal ser mere positive ud end sidste uge. Kort sagt er blodets tilstand ikke helt i top, men det går bestemt i den rigtige retning.

nodes.source: In order for me to be ready for any operation, my blood health must be much better than it currently is. The doctors will simply not operate if there is a chance of me getting an infection or not being able to fully bounce back from surgery.
nodes.text: Før jeg er klar til en operation, skal mine blodtal være meget bedre. Lægerne vil simpelthen ikke operere, hvis der er risiko for infektion eller for, at jeg ikke kan komme mig ordentligt bagefter.

nodes.source: Day by day now, I'm feeling better, trying to do more and more without overdoing it. I've been out to see my Mum for the first time in ages and have been to the supermarket to top up on my shopping. Although I'm doing things a lot slower than normal, at least I'm starting to do things for myself again after being weak for what seems like absolutely ages.
nodes.text: Jeg får det nu bedre dag for dag og prøver at gøre mere uden at overdrive. Jeg har besøgt mor for første gang i en evighed og været i supermarkedet efter forsyninger. Selvom jeg gør alting langsommere end normalt, er jeg i det mindste begyndt at klare ting selv igen efter at have været svag i, hvad der føles som en evighed.

nodes.source: Once I had struggled home through the traffic, I managed a big cooked breakfast for lunch, including some lovely scrambled ducks eggs!
nodes.text: Efter kampen hjem gennem trafikken fik jeg en stor varm morgenmad til frokost med dejlig røræg af andeæg!

nodes.source: Relaxed on the sofa until dinnertime!
nodes.text: Slappede af på sofaen indtil aftensmaden!

nodes.source: Occasionally I feel tired during the day and, quite frequently, catch the odd half hour here and there, not always being necessary and hopefully becoming less and less apparent as the days go on. I guess if my body is requesting sleep, I'll give it some sleep, but will be much happier when I can stay awake and alert for the whole day without weakening!
nodes.text: Indimellem er jeg træt om dagen og tager ret ofte en halv time hist og her. Ikke altid nødvendigt, og forhåbentlig bliver det mindre dag for dag. Hvis kroppen beder om søvn, får den det, men jeg bliver meget gladere, når jeg kan være vågen og opmærksom hele dagen uden at blive svag!

nodes.source: A nice dinner followed by strawberries and ice cream for dessert!
nodes.text: Dejlig middag med jordbær og is til dessert!

nodes.source: Time for more sleep soon.
nodes.text: Snart tid til mere søvn.

nodes.source: 16th March 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 16. marts 2005 - onsdag

nodes.source: Got up really late today after a long sleep in.
nodes.text: Stod meget sent op efter at have sovet længe.

nodes.source: Spent the day relaxing and eating well. Still feeling better although not doing too much at the moment.
nodes.text: Brugte dagen på at slappe af og spise godt. Stadig bedre, selvom jeg ikke laver så meget lige nu.

nodes.source: This evening I've felt very tired again, although I have good colour in my face and feel quite healthy. I hope this isn't a turning point to low health again. I really haven't done anything at all today that would make me tired out so am finding it a bit strange.
nodes.text: I aften blev jeg meget træt igen, selvom ansigtsfarven er god, og jeg føler mig sund. Jeg håber ikke, det er begyndelsen på en ny nedtur. Jeg har virkelig intet lavet, der kunne gøre mig udmattet, så det er lidt mærkeligt.

nodes.source: I'll get to bed and hope that I feel more sprightly tomorrow.
nodes.text: Jeg går i seng og håber på mere friskhed i morgen.

nodes.source: 17th March 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 17. marts 2005 - torsdag

nodes.source: Woke up early but didn't get up until midday today after a good sleep. Feeling OK, got quite a bit to do today, out and about. I hope I don't tire out too quickly.
nodes.text: Vågnede tidligt, men stod først op ved middagstid efter en god søvn. Har det okay og skal en del ud i dag. Håber ikke, jeg bliver for hurtigt træt.

nodes.source: Ken should be back from his break soon. I'll have updated X-Ray pictures, HCG results and some more photos for you to see imminently.
nodes.text: Ken er snart tilbage fra sin ferie. Der kommer meget snart nye røntgenbilleder, HCG-resultater og flere fotos.

nodes.source: After a hectic day out, I was really exhausted and glad to be home. I felt more tired than I normally would but still I understand that it's going to take a while for my body to come back to full stamina. I certainly don't feel as weak as I have done in the past. Straight to bed for a solid night's sleep, although a little troubled and apprehensive about my scan tomorrow.
nodes.text: Efter en hektisk dag ude var jeg virkelig udmattet og glad for at være hjemme. Mere træt end normalt, men jeg forstår stadig, at det tager tid at genvinde udholdenheden. Jeg føler mig bestemt ikke så svag som tidligere. Direkte i seng til en solid nats søvn, dog lidt urolig og ængstelig for morgendagens scanning.

nodes.source: 18th March 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 18. marts 2005 - fredag

nodes.source: CT Scan day today. I must eat something this morning to keep me going. As of 12pm I am not allowed to eat anything until after my scan at 4pm. During these 4 hours I have to drink a colouring agent called Gastrografin at 12pm, again at 2pm, then again when I arrive for the scan. I'm allowed to mix it with 300ml of orange squash, however it's not meant to taste that nice, I'll let you know!
nodes.text: CT-scanning i dag. Jeg må spise noget i morges for at holde mig i gang. Fra kl. 12 må jeg intet spise før efter scanningen kl. 16. I de fire timer skal jeg drikke kontraststoffet Gastrografin kl. 12, igen kl. 14 og igen ved ankomsten. Jeg må blande det med 300 ml appelsinsaftevand, men det skulle ikke smage så godt. Jeg skal nok fortælle jer det!

nodes.source: The drink wasn't too bad and I hope I suitably coloured my insides for a good clear scan.
nodes.text: Drikken var ikke så slem, og jeg håber, den farvede mit indre godt nok til en tydelig scanning.

nodes.source: Traffic was awful getting to the hospital, got there just after 4pm. Waited in the CT reception until about 5pm, when they started to prepare me for the scan. I think I tired my brain out with stress and almost fell asleep waiting.
nodes.text: Trafikken var forfærdelig, og jeg kom lidt efter kl. 16. Ventede i CT-receptionen til omkring kl. 17, da forberedelserne begyndte. Jeg tror, hjernen blev træt af stress, og jeg var nær ved at falde i søvn, mens jeg ventede.

nodes.source: At this stage I am frightened about what they are going to find inside my body. I'm being looked at through a magnifying glass and the result will determine what, if any, other operations are to be performed on my body. Apprehensive, nervous and worried; I couldn't think straight at all.
nodes.text: Nu er jeg bange for, hvad de finder inde i kroppen. Jeg bliver undersøgt under lup, og resultatet afgør, hvilke yderligere operationer der eventuelt skal udføres. Ængstelig, nervøs og bekymret. Jeg kunne slet ikke tænke klart.

nodes.source: Another small cup of colouring fluid, clear in colour with not much taste, then I was cannulated ready to be connected or 'interfaced' with the CT scanner.
nodes.text: Endnu en lille kop kontrastvæske, klar og næsten uden smag. Så fik jeg lagt venekanyle, klar til tilslutning, eller 'interface', med CT-scanneren.

nodes.source: I have some really good pictures of me inside the CT scanner which will be up in the gallery soon. Fortunately the CT operator owns the same digital camera as me and she didn't need any instruction on how to use mine!
nodes.text: Jeg har nogle rigtig gode billeder af mig i CT-scanneren, som snart kommer i galleriet. Heldigvis har radiografen samme digitalkamera som jeg, så hun behøvede ingen instruktion!

nodes.source: The scan took just under 10 minutes to complete, there is a recorded voice that asks to 'hold your breath' and 'breathe normally' during the scan. Halfway through, the CT scanner begins pumping yet another colouring fluid in to my veins, warning just beforehand that 'the injection is starting'.
nodes.text: Scanningen tog knap ti minutter. En optaget stemme beder en om at 'holde vejret' og 'trække vejret normalt'. Halvvejs begynder scanneren at pumpe endnu en kontrastvæske ind i venerne og advarer lige før: 'Indsprøjtningen starter.'

nodes.source: My only thoughts were to stay as still as possible during the scan, in the hope that the stiller I could be, the clearer the picture they would have of my insides.
nodes.text: Jeg tænkte kun på at ligge så stille som muligt i håb om, at jo mere stille jeg lå, desto tydeligere billeder fik de af mit indre.

nodes.source: It was all over quite quickly, my cannulation was removed almost painlessly and yet another hurdle in my journey has been overcome. The next is this Tuesday, the day I find out the results of my scan and how much cancer they need to cut out from inside my body.
nodes.text: Det var hurtigt overstået. Kanylen blev fjernet næsten smertefrit, og endnu en forhindring på rejsen er klaret. Den næste er tirsdag, hvor jeg får scanningssvar og ved, hvor meget kræft de skal skære ud af kroppen.

nodes.source: Milton was in at the hospital for another blood test and we managed to catch up with each other. We all went across the road for a Pizza Express. Traffic was quite bad being yet another Friday rush hour, so spending a little time catching up with Milton was much better than sitting in stationary traffic on the way home.
nodes.text: Milton var inde til endnu en blodprøve, så vi fik snakket. Vi gik alle over vejen på Pizza Express. Trafikken var slem, endnu en fredagsmyldretid, så lidt tid med Milton var meget bedre end at sidde i stillestående trafik hjem.

nodes.source: Once home, I felt quite tired again and managed about an hour's sleep on the sofa. These tired spells aren't normal for me at all, however I still feel ok before and after sleeping, it's just pure tiredness.
nodes.text: Hjemme blev jeg træt igen og sov cirka en time på sofaen. Det er slet ikke normalt for mig, men jeg har det stadig okay både før og efter. Det er bare ren træthed.

nodes.source: Spent a little time on front of the TV and managed a big bowl of fruit and ice cream as a late snack. Didn't get to bed too early as I just didn't feel tired enough after my nap earlier; once I did get to bed I soon drifted off to sleep.
nodes.text: Så lidt tv og fik en stor skål frugt og is som sen snack. Kom ikke så tidligt i seng, fordi jeg ikke var træt nok efter luren. Da jeg kom i seng, sov jeg hurtigt.

nodes.source: 19th March 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 19. marts 2005 - lørdag

nodes.source: Woke up quite early, but soon went back to bed and didn't wake up again until midday! The weather has been really nice over the past few days, going to try and spend some time outside today.
nodes.text: Vågnede ret tidligt, men gik snart i seng igen og vågnede først ved middagstid! Vejret har været dejligt de seneste dage, så jeg prøver at være lidt ude i dag.

nodes.source: Keeping my mind off of Tuesday's meeting is of paramount importance. I cannot avoid it and shouldn't worry until then, but it still plays on my mind from time to time. All I can do is hope that the chemotherapy has cleared the cancer cells in my body, enough to require only a minor operation. If my health and blood results are on the up, then the operation will be arranged for a date quite soon after Tuesday's meeting.
nodes.text: Det vigtigste er at holde tankerne fra mødet tirsdag. Jeg kan ikke undgå det og burde ikke bekymre mig før da, men det vender stadig tilbage. Jeg kan kun håbe, at kemoterapien har fjernet nok kræftceller til, at der kun kræves en mindre operation. Hvis helbred og blodtal er i bedring, bliver operationen planlagt ret hurtigt efter mødet.

nodes.source: Dropped my friend off at Heathrow Airport for a flight that I would have most certainly been on with him, if I hadn't been ill. A little heart wrenching, hopefully I will be on that flight one day.
nodes.text: Kørte min ven til Heathrow til et fly, jeg helt sikkert selv var taget med, hvis jeg ikke var syg. Lidt hjerteskærende. Forhåbentlig sidder jeg på det en dag.

nodes.source: Went over and spent some time with my Mum. The nice weather today helped her good spirits, which was added to with a fair amount of mobility.
nodes.text: Besøgte mor et stykke tid. Det gode vejr hjalp hendes humør, og hun kunne også bevæge sig ret godt.

nodes.source: Got home in good time for a big dinner before my first evening outing for what seems like an absolute age. Another friend is having a birthday party upstairs at my favourite bar in Richmond and I really wanted to show my face.
nodes.text: Kom hjem i god tid til en stor middag før min første aften ude i, hvad der føles som en evighed. En anden ven holder fødselsdag ovenpå min yndlingsbar i Richmond, og jeg vil virkelig gerne vise mig.

nodes.source: Got there at 22.00, lots of people were pleased to see me after such a long time. It was nice to be out although I did take a back seat from the partying and drank only cranberry juice all night. It was quite tiring being out and, once home, I was glad to get to bed.
nodes.text: Kom kl. 22, og mange var glade for at se mig efter så lang tid. Dejligt at være ude, selvom jeg holdt mig lidt i baggrunden og kun drak tranebærjuice. Det var ret trættende, og hjemme var jeg glad for at komme i seng.

nodes.source: 20th March 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 20. marts 2005 - søndag

nodes.source: Woke up at midday. Not much planned for today.
nodes.text: Vågnede ved middagstid. Ikke mange planer i dag.

nodes.source: Had a really big breakfast, although it was lunchtime!
nodes.text: En virkelig stor morgenmad, selvom det var frokosttid!

nodes.source: A few visitors came over to my house and I chatted the afternoon away while watching the Formula 1.
nodes.text: Nogle kom på besøg, og jeg snakkede eftermiddagen væk, mens vi så Formel 1.

nodes.source: Didn't get much done at all today.
nodes.text: Fik næsten intet gjort i dag.

nodes.source: I felt tired in the evening but my mind would not rest. I am constantly going over what is to become of me, despite trying to suppress the thoughts of the upcoming Tuesday meeting and my scan results. Believe me I have thought of every eventuality; if you've been following my story closely then I'm sure you can imagine what thoughts I've been having and how worrying they are. I'm very nervous about the thought of having operations, the easiest of which will be the orchiectomy I have to undergo, the rest, if any, are my biggest concern.
nodes.text: Jeg var træt om aftenen, men tankerne ville ikke hvile. Jeg tænker konstant på, hvad der bliver af mig, selvom jeg prøver at undertrykke tankerne om tirsdag og scanningssvaret. Tro mig, jeg har forestillet mig alle udfald. Har I fulgt historien nøje, kan I nok tænke jer mine bekymrende tanker. Jeg er meget nervøs ved tanken om operationer. Den letteste bliver fjernelsen af testiklen, som jeg skal igennem. De andre, hvis der bliver nogen, bekymrer mig mest.

nodes.source: 21st March 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 21. marts 2005 - mandag

nodes.source: Woke up at 09:00 today, I must stay awake in order to get to bed early tonight in preparation for my Tuesday meeting. Breakfast out of the way, I am going to do a few chores around the house and then set off to take my Mum to an important meeting for her at the local hospital.
nodes.text: Vågnede kl. 09. Jeg må holde mig vågen for at komme tidligt i seng før tirsdagens møde. Morgenmaden er overstået. Jeg ordner lidt derhjemme og kører så mor til en vigtig aftale på det lokale hospital.

nodes.source: Hospital, hospital, hospital, my life at the moment seems to revolve around hospital and will do for sometime to come!
nodes.text: Hospital, hospital, hospital. Mit liv drejer sig tilsyneladende om hospitaler lige nu og et godt stykke tid frem!

nodes.source: My Mum's test results have also been playing on my mind for quite some time. Thankfully all she needs is some dentistry work, nothing more than that. Phew.
nodes.text: Mors prøvesvar har også bekymret mig længe. Heldigvis skal hun kun have lavet tænder og intet andet. Pyha.

nodes.source: Now it's down to me to get a good result!
nodes.text: Nu mangler bare, at jeg får et godt resultat!

nodes.source: After a little potter around at some shops with my Mum, I took her home and then made for home myself. Not much time left before I find out now. I wonder if I will be able to get to sleep tonight!?
nodes.text: Efter lidt butikker med mor kørte jeg hende hjem og tog selv hjem. Nu er der ikke længe, til jeg får svaret. Mon jeg kan sove i nat!?

nodes.source: Two helpings of dinner and I was soon tired out enough to get to bed. Eventually I got to sleep at around 01:00.
nodes.text: To portioner aftensmad, og snart var jeg træt nok til seng. Til sidst faldt jeg i søvn omkring kl. 01.

nodes.source: 22nd March 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 22. marts 2005 - tirsdag

nodes.source: Woke up at about 07:00 this morning. Anxiety about today's meeting no doubt! I felt rested enough so was up and about by 09.00.
nodes.text: Vågnede omkring kl. 07. Utvivlsomt nervøs for dagens møde! Jeg følte mig udhvilet nok og var oppe og i gang kl. 09.

nodes.source: Had a big breakfast cooked for me this morning.
nodes.text: Der blev lavet en stor morgenmad til mig.

nodes.source: I'm 33 and 7 months old today!
nodes.text: Jeg er 33 år og syv måneder i dag!

nodes.source: Ken arrived back after being away for a few weeks and we all set off for the hospital.
nodes.text: Ken kom tilbage efter nogle uger væk, og vi tog alle på hospitalet.

nodes.source: Arrived in good time for my meeting and was soon seen to by my Doctor and Registrar. They had examined my CT scan results and I prepared myself nervously for the results.
nodes.text: Kom i god tid og blev snart tilset af lægen og reservelægen. De havde gennemgået CT-resultaterne, og jeg forberedte mig nervøst på svaret.

nodes.source: I will try to explain what was said to me as best I can, I've just got home and am typing this whilst the news sinks in and I can understand and accept it all myself.
nodes.text: Jeg vil prøve at forklare så godt som muligt, hvad de sagde. Jeg er lige kommet hjem og skriver, mens nyhederne trænger ind, så jeg selv kan forstå og acceptere det hele.

nodes.source: During the course of my treatment for Testicular Cancer, the chemotherapy has had an outstanding effect on what, by all accounts, was quite a serious and large spread of cancer. My blood results (tumour markers) have shown an outstanding response to the treatment, with the cancer showing no signs of recovery for over a month now.
nodes.text: Under behandlingen for testikelkræft har kemoterapien haft en enestående virkning på det, der efter alt at dømme var en ret alvorlig og omfattende spredning. Blodprøvernes tumormarkører har vist en fremragende reaktion, og kræften har nu ikke vist tegn på at komme igen i over en måned.

nodes.source: However, I still have tumours showing in my lungs and abdomen. A few very small tumour scars, along with two sizeable tumours in my lungs and one tumour almost 2cm in size on my abdomen. Without an operation, there is no way of telling if any of these tumours, or any tiny part of them, are still alive. All the signs so far show that they have died and may just be shrinking slowly over time as my body repairs itself.
nodes.text: Der ses dog stadig tumorer i lunger og bughule. Nogle meget små tumor-ar, to større tumorer i lungerne og én på næsten 2 cm i bughulen. Uden operation kan man ikke afgøre, om nogen af tumorerne eller selv en lille del stadig er levende. Alle tegn tyder hidtil på, at de er døde og måske blot svinder langsomt, mens kroppen reparerer sig.

nodes.source: So without an operation the gamble is to wait and find out if they are still alive. This could take some time and could mean that, if they are alive, they would mutate into another form of cancer which could put me at further risk in the future.
nodes.text: Uden operation er satsningen derfor at vente og se, om de stadig er levende. Det kan tage tid og betyde, at de i så fald muterer til en anden kræftform, som kan øge min risiko senere.

nodes.source: With an operation, the tumour would be entirely removed and unable to mutate or grow even if it was still alive.
nodes.text: Med en operation ville tumoren blive fjernet helt og kunne hverken mutere eller vokse, selv hvis den stadig var levende.

nodes.source: Bearing in mind that these tumours in my body could just be dead tissue which would fade over time.
nodes.text: Samtidig skal man huske, at tumorerne i kroppen måske bare er dødt væv, der forsvinder med tiden.

nodes.source: The conclusion is that the obvious and most important operation is to remove the testicle that started all of this off; that is a dead cert and relatively easy operation, which will be scheduled soon.
nodes.text: Konklusionen er, at den oplagte og vigtigste operation er at fjerne testiklen, hvor det hele begyndte. Det er helt sikkert og en forholdsvis let operation, som snart planlægges.

nodes.source: The outstanding decision is the slightly more serious operation on my abdomen to remove the 2cm tumour, a decision that will be taken tomorrow by my specialist Doctor along with another specialist Doctor, a Surgeon and a Radiologist.
nodes.text: Den uafklarede beslutning er den lidt alvorligere operation i bughulen for at fjerne tumoren på 2 cm. Den tager min speciallæge i morgen sammen med en anden speciallæge, en kirurg og en radiolog.

nodes.source: As I understand it, my Doctor likes to err on the side of caution and may decide to wait and see if the abdomen tumour shrinks any more before any surgery is required. However, the others in the team will most likely favour the operation being carried out as soon as possible, along with the testicle removal.
nodes.text: Som jeg forstår det, foretrækker min læge at være forsigtig og vil måske vente og se, om tumoren i bughulen skrumper mere, før operation er nødvendig. De andre i teamet vil dog sandsynligvis foretrække at operere hurtigst muligt samtidig med fjernelsen af testiklen.

nodes.source: At this stage I think there is a 60-70% that the abdomen operation will be carried out along with the testicle removal. Tomorrow, I will know for sure after the experts have had their patient meeting at the hospital.
nodes.text: Jeg vurderer nu sandsynligheden til 60-70 procent for, at bugoperationen bliver udført sammen med testikelfjernelsen. I morgen ved jeg det sikkert, når eksperterne har holdt patientkonference.

nodes.source: Operations on lungs are a more serious issue and the general practice is to let them be and keep a close eye on anything that remains. My lungs have shown a massive improvement and, like the abdomen, the hope is that the tumours showing are dead tissue and will recover over time. The likelihood is that I will not be having an operation on my lungs; instead they will be monitored over time with more X-rays and CT scans. If, after some time, they have not improved then my lungs will have to be operated on. This may change!
nodes.text: Lungeoperationer er mere alvorlige. Normalt lader man dem være og holder nøje øje med resterne. Mine lunger er væsentligt forbedret, og ligesom i bughulen håber man, at det synlige er dødt væv, som bedres med tiden. Sandsynligvis skal lungerne ikke opereres, men følges med flere røntgen- og CT-scanninger. Hvis de ikke er bedre efter nogen tid, skal jeg alligevel opereres i lungerne. Det kan ændre sig!

nodes.source: I went to the hospital today for some news and, on a scale of 1 to 10, 1 being brilliant news, I probably came away with a 6.
nodes.text: Jeg tog på hospitalet efter nyheder i dag. På en skala fra ét til ti, hvor ét er fantastiske nyheder, kom jeg nok hjem med et sekstal.

nodes.source: I will hear more tomorrow, but the general picture has been explained to me and my interpretation of it is above.
nodes.text: Jeg hører mere i morgen, men det overordnede billede er forklaret, og ovenfor står min fortolkning.

nodes.source: I had a blood test after the meeting and await the results of this over the next few days. This and future blood tests are mainly to monitor my general health and recovery from chemotherapy, along with another tumour test to monitor the status of my cancer (currently non active or dead).
nodes.text: Jeg fik blodprøve efter mødet og venter på svar de næste dage. Denne og fremtidige blodprøver skal især følge mit generelle helbred og restitution efter kemo, sammen med endnu en tumormarkørprøve til kræftens status, som i øjeblikket er inaktiv eller død.

nodes.source: How do I feel? Physically... quite good. Mentally... in shock (a little), nervous, externally; quiet and thinking.
nodes.text: Hvordan har jeg det? Fysisk... ganske godt. Mentalt... lidt i chok, nervøs. Udadtil stille og eftertænksom.

nodes.source: I have a choice and can make decisions about my operations. Given the dilemma, I think that it is best to follow the advice of the experts in charge. I really feel that I cannot make any decisions in isolation regarding my treatment as they are based on odds and are quite simply a gamble!
nodes.text: Jeg har et valg og kan træffe beslutninger om operationerne. I dette dilemma synes jeg, det er bedst at følge eksperternes råd. Jeg føler virkelig ikke, at jeg alene kan beslutte noget om behandlingen, når det bygger på sandsynligheder og ganske enkelt er et sats!

nodes.source: Managed to get over to my Mum's in the evening to explain face to face what I have learned so far.
nodes.text: Nåede over til mor i aften og forklarede ansigt til ansigt, hvad jeg indtil nu har fået at vide.

nodes.source: Home for dinner and I was fast asleep by 01:00. Tomorrow's another day!
nodes.text: Hjem til aftensmad, og jeg sov tungt kl. 01. I morgen er en ny dag!

nodes.source: 23rd March 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 23. marts 2005 - onsdag

nodes.source: Woke up early today, just one thing on my mind. My first thoughts as I opened my eyes were about my operations and how much of this cancer is actually dead inside my body. I just have no way of knowing. However, all the signs so far (including medical) suggest that it is.
nodes.text: Vågnede tidligt med kun én ting i hovedet. Da jeg åbnede øjnene, tænkte jeg straks på operationerne og på, hvor meget af kræften der faktisk er død inde i kroppen. Jeg kan ikke vide det. Men alle tegn, også de lægelige, tyder på det.

nodes.source: I'm beginning to get very scared, I could really cry at times and am probably crying inside already. My demeanour has changed somewhat, from being jovial to quiet contemplation. I'm certainly not in a chatty mood at the moment.
nodes.text: Jeg begynder at blive meget bange. Indimellem kunne jeg virkelig græde og græder nok allerede indvendigt. Jeg er gået fra munter til stille eftertænksomhed. Jeg er bestemt ikke snakkesalig lige nu.

nodes.source: The registrar at the hospital had a bit of trouble getting hold of me today, a mix up with my actual contact telephone number. Before finally getting hold of me, the hospital phoned my Mum and then a friend of mine, which worried them somewhat. The hospital isn't allowed to discuss anything with anyone but the patient, so calling someone else and saying "it's the hospital, we need to speak to Tim" can easily be taken the wrong way.
nodes.text: Reservelægen havde lidt svært ved at få fat i mig i dag på grund af forvirring om telefonnummeret. Før det lykkedes, ringede hospitalet til mor og en ven, og det bekymrede dem. Hospitalet må kun tale med patienten om sagen, så 'det er hospitalet, vi skal tale med Tim' til andre kan let misforstås.

nodes.source: My bloods have recovered almost to normal, which is a very good sign that my body is getting better quickly from the chemotherapy. I'm a healthy young man as the doctors put it (apart from the obvious).
nodes.text: Blodet er næsten normalt igen, et meget godt tegn på, at kroppen hurtigt kommer sig efter kemo. Jeg er en sund ung mand, som lægerne siger, bortset fra det åbenlyse.

nodes.source: The news is that my surgeon has decided to also operate on the abdomen and wishes to discuss this with me before he goes away for a week tomorrow. The hospital simply wanted me to get in for a meeting with him this afternoon to discuss my imminent surgery (within the next 2 weeks). Hence the urgency with which they were trying to get hold of me.
nodes.text: Nyheden er, at kirurgen også har besluttet at operere i bughulen og vil tale med mig, inden han rejser væk en uge fra i morgen. Hospitalet ville bare have mig ind til et møde med ham i eftermiddag om den nært forestående operation inden for de næste to uger. Derfor havde de så travlt med at få fat i mig.

nodes.source: Once I arrived at the hospital, I was soon seen by not only my surgeon but also my doctor, the registrar and the Macmillan nurse. Everyone at hand for me and my questions. The surgeon came across very confident about the operation and explained to me in detail how it would be carried out.
nodes.text: På hospitalet kom jeg hurtigt ind til både kirurgen, lægen, reservelægen og Macmillan-sygeplejersken. Alle klar til mig og mine spørgsmål. Kirurgen virkede meget sikker på operationen og forklarede præcist, hvordan den foregår.

nodes.source: Dr Tim Christmas' reputation precedes him (he's my surgeon). These particular operations are certainly not unfamiliar to him. I have been told that people are sent to him from all over the country and sometimes all over the world. It appears that Charing Cross Hospital and its patients are very lucky to benefit from his expertise.
nodes.text: Dr. Tim Christmas' ry er kommet ham i forkøbet. Han er min kirurg, og disse operationer er bestemt ikke fremmede for ham. Jeg har fået at vide, at patienter henvises fra hele landet og nogle gange hele verden. Charing Cross og patienterne er tilsyneladende heldige at få gavn af hans ekspertise.

nodes.source: A somewhat comforting thought.
nodes.text: En lidt beroligende tanke.

nodes.source: I am still nervous about my pending operation; who wouldn't be? I will end up with a sizeable scar in my groin and an even more sizeable scar down the centre of my stomach. There will be before and after pictures on here for all to see (no rude bits, I'm afraid)!
nodes.text: Jeg er stadig nervøs for operationen. Hvem ville ikke være det? Jeg får et stort ar i lysken og et endnu større ned langs midten af maven. Her kommer før- og efterbilleder til alle, dog ingen frække detaljer, desværre!

nodes.source: The date of my operation is now posted in the schedules area of this website. They have not been confirmed to me in writing as yet, so may be subject to change.
nodes.text: Operationsdatoen er nu lagt ind i hjemmesidens aftaleplan. Jeg har endnu ikke fået skriftlig bekræftelse, så datoerne kan ændres.

nodes.source: In the mean time, I just have to keep myself busy. My blood health and results have returned to normal now, this was confirmed to me not only on the phone earlier but also in the meeting. I am lucky to have my health and be able to recover quite quickly by normal standards. Not so much in terms of fitness but general health I am in pretty damn good shape apart from the obvious!
nodes.text: Indtil da må jeg holde mig beskæftiget. Blodprøver og blodets tilstand er normale nu, både bekræftet i telefonen og på mødet. Jeg er heldig at have godt helbred og kunne komme mig hurtigt efter normale standarder. Ikke så meget med konditionen, men generelt er jeg i pokkers god form, bortset fra det åbenlyse!

nodes.source: On the way home I was still trying to soak up all that I had been told, hopefully I will be able to expand on it more once I have digested all the information myself.
nodes.text: På vej hjem prøvede jeg stadig at tage det hele ind. Forhåbentlig kan jeg uddybe det, når jeg selv har fordøjet oplysningerne.

nodes.source: Very bad traffic on the way home; went to Sainsbury's to top up on some food shopping.
nodes.text: Meget slem trafik hjem. Tog til Sainsbury's efter flere madvarer.

nodes.source: After I had my dinner, I popped over to spend the latter part of the evening with my Mum to expand further on my call to her earlier in the day. As you can imagine, each and every time I get more news I am immediately passing it on to my Mum & Dad by phone.
nodes.text: Efter aftensmad besøgte jeg mor den sidste del af aftenen og uddybede det tidligere telefonopkald. Som I kan forestille jer, ringer jeg straks med nye oplysninger til både mor og far hver gang.

nodes.source: Once home, I finally got to sleep at about 2am.
nodes.text: Hjemme faldt jeg endelig i søvn omkring kl. 2.

nodes.source: 24th March 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 24. marts 2005 - torsdag

nodes.source: Woke up at 11am. A good deep sleep.
nodes.text: Vågnede kl. 11 efter en god, dyb søvn.

nodes.source: Soon after I had eaten breakfast the registrar called to confirm the last part of my blood results. My HCG tumour marker still remains at below 2 or untraceable. So good news that potentially none of this cancer showing inside me is alive and what isn't going to be removed will hopefully disappear over time.
nodes.text: Kort efter morgenmaden ringede reservelægen med sidste del af blodprøvesvarene. HCG-tumormarkøren er stadig under 2, altså ikke påviselig. Gode nyheder, som tyder på, at ingen af de synlige kræftrester er levende, og at det, der ikke fjernes, forhåbentlig forsvinder med tiden.

nodes.source: A question that I have been meaning to ask for some time about my cancer was answered today. As I have shown particularly good recovery so far, does this mean that my cancer will also recover too? After all, the cancer was created in my body, I did wonder if it would recover as well as my body has. The answer is no. Generally in healthier people the battle is hard but the clear up rate is much better than with people who have poor health when they are admitted with cancer. Another lesson, look after yourselves and make sure you are in good health!
nodes.text: Et spørgsmål, jeg længe har villet stille, blev besvaret i dag. Når jeg kommer mig særlig godt, betyder det så også, at kræften gør det? Den blev trods alt skabt i min krop, og jeg spekulerede på, om den ville komme sig lige så godt. Svaret er nej. Generelt er kampen hård også for raske mennesker, men helbredelsesraten er meget bedre end hos dem, der har dårligt helbred ved indlæggelsen. Endnu en lære: Pas på jer selv og hold jer sunde!

nodes.source: Keeping myself busy today, trying not to think about things too much. I have a bit of time away from hospital now before any further tests are carried out.
nodes.text: Holder mig beskæftiget og prøver ikke at tænke for meget. Nu har jeg lidt tid væk fra hospitalet før flere undersøgelser.

nodes.source: Got to bed quite late again. I must get back in to a normal sleeping pattern.
nodes.text: Ret sent i seng igen. Jeg må tilbage til normal søvnrytme.

nodes.source: 25th March 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 25. marts 2005 - fredag

nodes.source: Easter weekend! Woke up feeling good. Nice to see the sun shining. Not much to report. I'm feeling in good health and eating well.
nodes.text: Påskeweekend! Vågnede med det godt. Dejligt at se solen. Ikke meget at fortælle. Jeg føler mig sund og spiser godt.

nodes.source: Apart from the obvious stress of my pending operations I'm going to continue to lead as normal a life as possible and feasible under the current circumstances.
nodes.text: Ud over den oplagte stress ved de forestående operationer fortsætter jeg så normalt et liv som muligt og forsvarligt under omstændighederne.

nodes.source: I'll not bore you with mundane daily reports of my movements!
nodes.text: Jeg vil ikke kede jer med banale dagsrapporter om mine gøremål!

nodes.source: If anything happens, I'll be back here to tell. Otherwise see you all again on the 5th April 2005.
nodes.text: Hvis der sker noget, fortæller jeg det her. Ellers ses vi den 5. april 2005.

nodes.source: April 2005
nodes.text: april 2005

nodes.source: 5th April 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 5. april 2005 - tirsdag

nodes.source: Arrived at the hospital just before the blood testing room closed at Clinic 8 for the morning.
nodes.text: Kom på hospitalet lige før blodprøverummet i klinik 8 lukkede for formiddagen.

nodes.source: Ordered up my own blood tests as no reference to what was needed could be found. Full Blood Count, U&E's inc. Magnesium, Tumour Markers (HCG, LDH, AFP). How do I remember all that? After some 4 months of treatment and blood tests, you can pretty much become an expert in knowing what's required at times!
nodes.text: Bestilte selv blodprøverne, da de ikke kunne finde nogen henvisning til de nødvendige prøver. Fuld blodtælling, urinstof og elektrolytter inklusive magnesium, tumormarkører HCG, LDH og AFP. Hvordan husker jeg alt det? Efter cirka fire måneders behandling og blodprøver bliver man næsten ekspert i, hvad der sommetider kræves!

nodes.source: I will not have any results from the blood tests until tomorrow at the earliest.
nodes.text: Jeg får tidligst blodprøvesvar i morgen.

nodes.source: I've been feeling pretty healthy over the past week or so. Still catching my breath a little if I do too much; this is probably more to do with the fact that I'm out of condition than in poor health. The strangest feeling is knowing there is still cancer inside my body (hopefully dead) and thinking ahead to my operation next week, asking myself "why do I need it, I feel OK". Obviously I know the real answers but it's a weird feeling knowing that soon I will be undergoing major surgery for what appears from the outside to be for no reason at all.
nodes.text: Jeg har følt mig ret sund den seneste uge. Stadig lidt forpustet, hvis jeg gør for meget. Det skyldes nok snarere dårlig kondition end dårligt helbred. Det mærkeligste er at vide, at der stadig er kræft inde i kroppen, forhåbentlig død, og tænke på næste uges operation: 'Hvorfor skal jeg have den? Jeg har det jo okay.' Selvfølgelig kender jeg de rigtige svar, men det er mærkeligt at vide, at jeg snart skal gennem en stor operation, der set udefra tilsyneladende er uden grund.

nodes.source: I get the odd twinge in my lungs, nothing painful or awkward and perhaps I only perceive it mentally. It certainly serves as a sobering reminder of what may be in store for me with regard to my lungs and any operations that may be required of them in the future.
nodes.text: Jeg mærker af og til et stik i lungerne, ikke smertefuldt eller generende og måske kun noget, jeg forestiller mig. Det er i hvert fald en alvorlig påmindelse om, hvad der måske venter med lungerne og eventuelle senere operationer.

nodes.source: I have accepted the fact that next week I will be on an operating table. I will be undergoing a major procedure called an RPLND as well as an Orchiectomy, all in the same sitting. Quite an ordeal for my body: it will be approximately a 1 hour operation, 3-5 days recovery in hospital and a further 2-3 weeks at home, doing not much at all.
nodes.text: Jeg har accepteret, at jeg ligger på operationsbordet næste uge. Jeg skal både have det store indgreb RPLND og fjernet en testikel under samme bedøvelse. En prøvelse for kroppen: cirka en times operation, tre-fem dages restitution på hospitalet og yderligere to-tre uger hjemme uden at lave meget.

nodes.source: I have been told that, in my case, the RPLND will be quite a quick and easy procedure for the surgeon to complete due to the small size of the tumour he is removing (approx. 2cm in diameter). However, it still means that I will have a substantial scar down the centre of my stomach, some 6-10 inches in length.
nodes.text: Jeg har fået at vide, at RPLND i mit tilfælde er ret hurtig og let for kirurgen, fordi tumoren kun er cirka 2 cm i diameter. Alligevel får jeg et betydeligt ar ned midt på maven, omkring seks-ti tommer langt.

nodes.source: Believe me, I'm scared of what lies ahead for me. I'm trying to stay positive and keep my mind off my forthcoming agenda but time is getting thin now, the operation and its undeniable results are looming over me. I haven't been getting to sleep very quickly or easily at night. My mind races with apprehensive thoughts, although when I do finally sleep, I sleep well and deeply (I've never had a problem there!)
nodes.text: Tro mig, jeg er bange for det, der venter. Jeg prøver at være positiv og tænke på andet, men tiden bliver kort, og operationen med sine uundgåelige følger hænger over mig. Jeg falder ikke hurtigt eller let i søvn. Tankerne kredser nervøst, men når jeg endelig sover, er det godt og dybt. Der har jeg aldrig haft problemer!

nodes.source: My phone has been quiet, which I thank you all for, the more I talk about "how I am" and "how I feel" worries me more and more each day. The more I keep my mind off things and just get on with it, the better I'll be. Your messages of support are still greatly appreciated; it's comforting to see all the support I have out there.
nodes.text: Telefonen har været stille, og tak for det. Jo mere jeg taler om, hvordan jeg har det og føler mig, desto mere bekymret bliver jeg. Jo mere jeg kan tænke på andet og bare fortsætte, desto bedre. Jeres støttebeskeder er stadig meget værdsat. Det er en trøst at se al støtten derude.

nodes.source: I'll be back to report on my blood results as soon as I receive them.
nodes.text: Jeg skriver om blodprøverne, så snart jeg får svar.

nodes.source: I'll probably repeat myself a bit as everything's going over and over in my mind, more and more with each passing day.
nodes.text: Jeg gentager nok mig selv lidt. Alt kører rundt og rundt i hovedet, mere for hver dag.

nodes.source: 7th April 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 7. april 2005 - torsdag

nodes.source: Managed to get up early after another late night last night. Had to get myself to the garage early to sort some things out for my car.
nodes.text: Kom tidligt op efter endnu en sen nat. Jeg skulle tidligt på værkstedet for at ordne nogle ting med bilen.

nodes.source: The tiredness caught up with me this afternoon while visiting my Mum and I had a quick snooze. The stress of this forthcoming operation is beginning to catch up with me; I almost got myself quite upset today whilst talking to my Mum, a few tears showing. The additional operation (RPLND) I am to have is not exactly the ideal scenario I had hoped for, but I have to keep positive, strong and, most of all, keep moving forward. Something I don't always find it easy to focus on. Understandable, given the circumstances, I guess.
nodes.text: Trætheden indhentede mig i eftermiddag hos mor, og jeg tog en hurtig lur. Operationsstressen begynder at indhente mig. Jeg blev næsten helt opløst under samtalen med mor i dag, med nogle tårer fremme. Den ekstra RPLND-operation er ikke det ideelle forløb, jeg havde håbet, men jeg må forblive positiv, stærk og især fortsætte fremad. Det er ikke altid let at fokusere på. Forståeligt under omstændighederne, vel.

nodes.source: My blood results came through by phone late this afternoon. I'm still not 100% (probably about 60% - 70%) in terms of blood health, but it's good enough to go for my operation next week. I will have another blood test on the day before my operation and, if required, may need another blood transfusion to top things up a little. This explains my unfit feelings recently, it's not that apparent but I have noticed a reduction in performance from my body, at least from what I am used to being able to do (pre diagnosis).
nodes.text: Blodprøvesvarene kom telefonisk sent på eftermiddagen. Blodets tilstand er stadig ikke hundrede procent, nok omkring 60-70 procent, men god nok til operationen næste uge. Jeg får en ny blodprøve dagen før, og om nødvendigt måske endnu en transfusion for at fylde lidt op. Det forklarer, at jeg har følt mig i dårlig form. Ikke særligt tydeligt, men kroppen præsterer mindre end det, jeg er vant til fra før diagnosen.

nodes.source: My HCG tumour marker still remains below 2 or untraceable, which is positive news. I have added the latest test date to the HCG results section of the site.
nodes.text: HCG-tumormarkøren er stadig under 2, ikke påviselig. Det er positivt. Jeg har tilføjet den seneste prøvedato på HCG-resultatsiden.

nodes.source: It's about time I updated my symptoms...
nodes.text: Tid til en ny symptomoversigt...

nodes.source: Tiredness
nodes.text: Træthed

nodes.source: (infrequently)
nodes.text: (sjældent)

nodes.source: Tinnitus
nodes.text: Tinnitus

nodes.source: (chemo side effect, sometimes annoying)
nodes.text: (kemobivirkning, sommetider generende)

nodes.source: Hair loss
nodes.text: Hårtab

nodes.source: (a light fluff appearing)
nodes.text: (lette dun begynder at komme)

nodes.source: Itchy face
nodes.text: Kløende ansigt

nodes.source: (due to hair growth returning)
nodes.text: (fordi håret vokser ud igen)

nodes.source: Bruised fingers
nodes.text: Fingre føles som blå mærker

nodes.source: , small sores appearing (long gone)
nodes.text: , små sår dukker op (for længst væk)

nodes.source: Oral Thrush
nodes.text: Svamp i munden

nodes.source: (long gone)
nodes.text: (for længst væk)

nodes.source: Tiger stripes on skin
nodes.text: Tigerstriber på huden

nodes.source: (still apparent, a chemo side effect)
nodes.text: (stadig synlige, en kemobivirkning)

nodes.source: Bowel Movements
nodes.text: Afføring

nodes.source: (very occasional pain, pretty much back to normal)
nodes.text: (meget sjældne smerter, stort set normalt igen)

nodes.source: Night Sweats
nodes.text: Nattesved

nodes.source: (gone)
nodes.text: (væk)

nodes.source: Cough
nodes.text: Hoste

nodes.source: (very occasional, slight, different to before)
nodes.text: (meget sjældent, let, anderledes end før)

nodes.source: Temperature and chills
nodes.text: Feber og kulderystelser

nodes.source: (none)
nodes.text: (ingen)

nodes.source: Nausea
nodes.text: Kvalme

nodes.source: (none).
nodes.text: (ingen).

nodes.source: Spoke to my Dad today - as I do most days - to update him with the latest news. He is coming on the 13th when I'm admitted to hospital, and will be with me before I go in to theatre for my surgery the following day. He asked if there was anything I needed him to bring up; I just said "some courage".
nodes.text: Talte med far i dag, som de fleste dage, og gav ham sidste nyt. Han kommer den 13., når jeg bliver indlagt, og er hos mig før operationen dagen efter. Han spurgte, om jeg skulle have noget med. Jeg sagde bare: 'Lidt mod.'

nodes.source: Until the 12th of April then... which is when I have a quick and very easy visit to the hospital for an ultrasound.
nodes.text: Så indtil den 12. april... hvor jeg har et hurtigt og meget enkelt hospitalsbesøg til ultralyd.

nodes.source: The date that is playing on my mind the most is Thursday the 14th April, the day of my operation. I somehow feel that I will never be the same again after that day.
nodes.text: Den dato, jeg tænker mest på, er torsdag den 14. april, operationsdagen. På en eller anden måde føler jeg, at jeg aldrig bliver helt den samme efter den dag.

nodes.source: 9th April 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 9. april 2005 - søndag

nodes.source: Today marks 4 months exactly since diagnosis.
nodes.text: I dag er det præcis fire måneder siden diagnosen.

nodes.source: It has been an unpleasant 4 month lesson in human mortality. There is light at the end of the tunnel but this is far from over yet, I'm still nervous about my forthcoming operation and the results that will transpire.
nodes.text: Fire ubehagelige måneder med undervisning i menneskets dødelighed. Der er lys for enden af tunnelen, men det er langtfra slut. Jeg er stadig nervøs for operationen og de resultater, der kommer frem.

nodes.source: I have received some really supportive emails recently, for which I am eternally grateful. One of which read...
nodes.text: Jeg har fået virkelig støttende e-mails på det seneste, og dem er jeg evigt taknemmelig for. En lød sådan...

nodes.source: "I know there is probably no telling you right now, but I have been there recently and you shouldn't worry. I bet you, like me will be checking out of hospital on the Monday morning following your op, feeling nothing but a little sore and you like me, now 3 months on, will feel exactly the same as you did before, and you will be cancer free."
nodes.text: »Jeg ved, at du nok ikke vil høre det lige nu, men jeg har selv været igennem det for nylig, og du skal ikke bekymre dig. Jeg vil vædde på, at du ligesom jeg bliver udskrevet mandag morgen efter operationen med kun lidt ømhed. Og ligesom jeg nu tre måneder senere vil du have det præcis som før og være kræftfri.«

nodes.source: Very comforting to read, amongst many other emails, it's something I will most certainly keep in mind to help me through the coming days.
nodes.text: Meget trøstende at læse blandt de mange e-mails. Det vil jeg bestemt huske som hjælp gennem de kommende dage.

nodes.source: I managed to spend the day with my Mum today. We went to Richmond Park for some fresh air, tea and cakes! I hope to be spending many more days out with my Mum in the future.
nodes.text: Jeg fik tilbragt dagen med mor. Vi tog til Richmond Park for frisk luft, te og kage! Jeg håber på mange flere udflugter med mor i fremtiden.

nodes.source: Just one 'whole' day left for me now, before I start my hospital business.
nodes.text: Nu er der kun én 'hel' dag tilbage, før hospitalsforløbet begynder.

nodes.source: 12th April 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 12. april 2005 - tirsdag

nodes.source: I woke up quite early and suddenly this morning. I immediately felt my stomach wondering if there was a scar there or not. I cannot remember dreaming and slept very well, however I guess I must have 'lived' the operation in my sleep and awoke to find no scar!
nodes.text: Vågnede ret tidligt og brat i morges. Jeg mærkede straks på maven og spekulerede på, om der var et ar. Jeg husker ingen drøm og sov rigtig godt, men jeg må nok have 'gennemlevet' operationen i søvne og vågnede uden ar!

nodes.source: Just goes to show that this is really starting to play on my mind now. I cannot pinpoint exactly what is worrying me so much, probably the aftermath and results of this forthcoming operation. Also, it is my first ever major operation under general anaesthetic; I have some reservations about that too!
nodes.text: Det viser bare, hvor meget det fylder nu. Jeg kan ikke præcis sige, hvad der bekymrer mig så meget, nok tiden efter og operationens resultater. Det er også min første store operation i fuld bedøvelse. Det har jeg også mine betænkeligheder ved!

nodes.source: I'm off to have an Ultrasound scan today at 11.45. I'm also going to try to find my Doctor for a quick word and to pop up and have a look at the ward I am scheduled to stay in.
nodes.text: Jeg skal til ultralydsscanning kl. 11.45 i dag. Jeg prøver også at finde lægen til en kort snak og kigge på afdelingen, hvor jeg skal ligge.

nodes.source: ...back home now. Had a good look at my Ultrasound scan while it was being carried out. The doctor was very helpful and showed me all that there was to see, pointing out on screen all the bad bits in my right testicle. I'll be rid of it on Thursday!
nodes.text: ...hjemme igen. Jeg fik et godt kig på ultralydsscanningen undervejs. Lægen var hjælpsom og viste alt og udpegede de dårlige områder i højre testikel på skærmen. Torsdag slipper jeg af med den!

nodes.source: Afterwards, Ken and I went for a bit of a search about in the hospital for my Doctor and also had a look at the 8th floor ward which I am to be recovering in.
nodes.text: Bagefter ledte Ken og jeg lidt efter min læge og så også på afdelingen på 8. etage, hvor jeg skal komme mig.

nodes.source: Managed to catch up with my Registrar and Doctor, both of whom again tried to allay my fears about my forthcoming operation. There just seems to be no telling me at the moment, but I guess every bit of reassurance I get will slowly chip away at the barriers and worries I have built up for myself.
nodes.text: Fik fat i reservelægen og lægen, som igen prøvede at berolige mig om operationen. Lige nu er jeg vist ikke til at tale til fornuft, men hver beroligelse må langsomt bryde de barrierer og bekymringer ned, jeg har bygget op.

nodes.source: I introduced myself to the sister in charge of 8 North; she filled me in on some of the things I am to expect once I'm admitted tomorrow and also some of the tubes and machines that will be around me once I come out from surgery. It doesn't sound pleasant in the slightest. I will know more tomorrow once I'm at the hospital which is tentatively arranged for 14.30.
nodes.text: Jeg præsenterede mig for afdelingssygeplejersken på 8 North. Hun fortalte lidt om, hvad jeg kan vente efter indlæggelsen i morgen, og om slangerne og maskinerne omkring mig efter operationen. Det lyder ikke det mindste rart. Jeg ved mere i morgen, når jeg er på hospitalet, foreløbigt aftalt til kl. 14.30.

nodes.source: My Tinnitus is much more apparent today, perhaps connected to the increasing stress I am feeling.
nodes.text: Min tinnitus er meget tydeligere i dag, måske forbundet med den voksende stress.

nodes.source: I'm staying at my Mum's house tonight. I will not be able to see her again for quite some time after tomorrow's admission to hospital. Although, once I'm home there will, of course, be times when she can come to see me while I recover.
nodes.text: Jeg sover hos mor i nat. Efter indlæggelsen i morgen kan jeg ikke se hende i et godt stykke tid. Når jeg er hjemme igen, vil der selvfølgelig være mulighed for, at hun besøger mig under restitutionen.

nodes.source: 13th April 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 13. april 2005 - onsdag

nodes.source: Woke up suddenly at 05:00 this morning but managed to get back off to sleep shortly after. Again, no dreams apparent, but there's certainly something going on up there in that brain of mine!
nodes.text: Vågnede brat kl. 05, men faldt snart i søvn igen. Ingen tydelige drømme, men der foregår bestemt noget i hjernen!

nodes.source: Finally got up at around 09:30 this morning, got myself together and then helped my Mum get herself together. For me, saying goodbye to my Mum this morning felt like a final farewell. I know it's not, but I found it hard and was quite emotional. My Mum is full of hope and encouragement for me.
nodes.text: Stod endelig op omkring kl. 09.30, gjorde mig klar og hjalp mor med at blive klar. At sige farvel til hende føltes som et sidste farvel. Jeg ved, at det ikke er det, men det var svært og følelsesladet. Mor er fuld af håb og opmuntring.

nodes.source: I called the Hospital admissions department as instructed at 12:00, only to be told that instructions from the bed manager on my intended ward had not been relayed as yet and it would be best if they called me when they were ready. I hope this delay does not have a knock on or rushed effect with regard to my preparation for surgery which is supposed to be taking place tomorrow.
nodes.text: Ringede som aftalt til indlæggelsesafdelingen kl. 12, men fik at vide, at sengeansvarlige på min afdeling endnu ikke havde sendt besked. Det var bedst, at de ringede, når de var klar. Jeg håber ikke, forsinkelsen skubber eller forhaster forberedelserne til operationen i morgen.
